notes.title: New Map is now playable!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35435106/4295b688983a2d273f7036e345e12740c8e6a448.png[/img]

[h2]Greetings Friendly Neighbors, [/h2]

Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

After long time of slumber, here we wanted to announce a new exciting arena for you to play with your friends. Warehouse map featuring new obstacles and platform ground that hopefully you like. This map is made different from other signature map in the game such as ordinary day, storm, and retro map. Inspired from many action film's fight scene in warehouse, we think this might be a good place to add into the game collection. Instead of natural obstacles, here you are faced with normal things you find in common warehouse.

And if you like this game, please recommend this to your friends and family so that we can add more exciting concept in this game, including game modes, characters and maps.ːsteamhappyː

Finally, keep in touch with us on 
instagram.com/benuasoftworks
or email us at support@benuasoftworks.com

[b]We wish you a joyful holiday![/b]
